# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of this project seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please report it to us as described below.

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, please report them to the repository maintainers privately by using GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature on this repository.

### What to include in your report

*   A description of the vulnerability.
*   Steps to reproduce the issue.
*   Potential impact of the vulnerability.

### What to expect

*   You will receive an acknowledgment of your report as soon as possible.
*   We will investigate the issue and keep you updated on the progress of the fix.
*   Once the issue is resolved, we will publish a security advisory and credit you for the discovery (if you wish).
